description.value: Copper Mountain Inn is a motel in downtown Princeton, BC, situated in the Similkameen Valley with views of the surrounding mountains and river. It sits close to the China Creek Trail, the Bridge of Dreams, and the Similkameen River, making it a convenient rest stop for cyclists travelling the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) corridor. The property offers 24/7 guest services and markets itself as a comfortable base for exploring the Princeton area.
